discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) as an incretin hormone and its development into GLP-1 receptor agonist therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology went from basic peptide endocrinology to drugs that are transforming the treatment of diabetes, obesity and cardiometabolic disease. Habener, Mojsov and Knudsen already hold the Lasker (2024) and Breakthrough Prizes for this work. The 2025 prize was for immunology (regulatory T cells) and 2024 for microRNA, so a metabolic and translational prize fits the committee's rotation.
